scope: Independent read-only review of S1 handler transaction behavior, metadata preservation, and API coverage. No handler/test edits made.
snapshot_note: Coherent first implementation/tests provided by owner while first remote gate ran; owner already working on RUN_ID relationships, low-level snapshot matching, and aggregate metadata allocation, so these known items are not duplicated.

findings.trigger: Set max_blob_bytes=16; use lossless Source-policy write_spectra with three zero-valued peaks and a short native ID. Coordinate/intensity raw arrays are24 bytes but zlib compress to11 bytes.
findings.issue: Writer checks compressed output through zlib_encode but does not check uncompressed raw byte length; read arrays uses zlib_decode capped at16, so the successfully written arrays cannot be read with the same limits.
findings.fix: Check/charge uncompressed array size before construction/encode, as well as compressed size. Add small exact-limit regression.
findings.evidence: Rust source trace and independent Python zlib confirmation24->11; no Rust reproduction was run by this reviewer.

findings.trigger: Full metadata experiment with valid native ID and a nonempty metadata FloatList under sampled noise m/z array (or other supported sampled-noise role).
findings.issue: spectrum_metadata retains noise metadata, and mzML writer emits these independent arrays even with cleared primary peaks. RUN_EXTRA read sets max_total_array_elements=0, so a full write can succeed but subsequent full read rejects its own metadata array. Two-arrays-per-record cap can also exclude the extra independent grids.
findings.fix: Preserve and budget supported independent metadata arrays in snapshot reads, or reject explicitly before committing writes; add noise-grid round-trip regression.
findings.evidence: Rust source trace through mzml_record::NOISE and existing mzml_typed_transport test noise_empty_mismatched_lengths_and_empty_spectrum_are_preserved; no new Rust reproduction by this reviewer.

api_coverage: All explicit public source operations have native counterparts; no missing operation found in bounded review.
transactions: Public write helpers share one transaction and update counters after commit; late-write rollback tests exist. No additional transactional finding beyond owner-known pending items.
delivery: Both findings sent to handler owner and integrating root; owner is responsible for reproduction/fixes.
